test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an adverbial usage error.

Mr. Arun / will pay dear / for his / financial mistake.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect adverbial form "**dear**" used in place of "**dearly**."
 
• Adverbs are used to modify verbs, and in this case, "**dearly**" is the correct adverb to modify "**pay**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**will pay dearly**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part A** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Arun will pay dearly for his financial mistake."*
